item.title: Rarely seen bobcat activity caught on camera in Sarasota
item.description: SARASOTA Fla. (WSNN) - Some rarely captured bobcat activity has been captured on camera. A Facebook post from Sarasota County Government shows two bobcats moving quietly in single file, a behavior often seen during the tail end of bobcat breeding season here in Florida. item.title: Florida mother arrested in connection with death of 3-year-old daughter: sheriff
